- **Port**: 8443

```bash
GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null" \
  git clone ssh://git@localhost:/git/project

When prompted for a password, enter: `password`

Alternatively, use `sshpass`:
```bash
GIT_SSH_COMMAND="sshpass -p password ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PubkeyAuthentication=no" \
  git clone ssh://git@localhost:/git/project
```
